theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+1.38%) and Utilities (+0.61%) led the market today, while Health Care (-0.82%) and Technology (-0.40%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.11%, defensives -0.02%, and value/cyclicals +0.53% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.17%, Dow -0.20%, Nasdaq -0.28% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.51%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 2.60% to 14.25, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 1.20% to $4,432.00, crude oil was little changed at $82.40, and bitcoin slipped 0.92% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
